findings.label: Audit-explorer permission choice
findings.detail: GET /api/platform/audit-events is gated on platform.security.respond; design §7.5 pins no key here. Defensible platform-scoped choice. Confirm intent or switch to platform.support.grant for consistency with the other grant endpoints. Non-blocking.

findings.label: Step-up action class defaults from request body
findings.detail: POST /api/auth/mfa/verify defaults action to 'support_grant.create' from the body. Safe because requireStepUp(actionClass) checks the class server-side at the point of action, so a token can only be used against the class it is bound to. Informational, non-blocking.

findings.label: Guard 403/401 shapes not in service unit tests
findings.detail: Spec step 7d lists guard-response-shape assertions; these are covered by the 20/20 live smoke (platform 403 until enrolled, 401 without/with wrong step-up class) rather than a dedicated route unit test. Non-blocking given the smoke evidence; consider adding a route-level test later.
